operations.contract: RGBA raster + fieldScale + orientations + widthsSrc -> support Float32Array and bestTheta Float32Array; keeps MAX score across width/orientation, discards winning width. Paired inward-minus-outward RGB gradients must have positive dot; score=min(norms)*cosine; global positive-score percentile normalization then gamma. buildSupportCost -> 1+costMultiplier*(1-support)^2.
operations.unitsFrames: widthsSrc full canonical source px; half-width/scale in support cells; orientation tangent radians modulo pi; support dimensionless relative contrast, not calibrated probability/alpha. Resize dims=floor(image dims/scale); blur sigma support cells.
operations.limitation: Cannot infer width posterior or center uncertainty from returned field; changing bank changes global normalization, so normalized support is not pointwise monotone.

operations.contract: Pure point/heading/expected-width sensor; FOUR sampled lanes at [-W/2,-W/6,+W/6,+W/2], dividing three W/3 intervals. Outside guards +/-2W/3; rail differences +/-edgeDeltaPx, inner lift against guards. Score=min(available rail and inner scores); missing/occluded remains null. No heading/width search or ownership.
operations.unitsFrames: image px, heading rad, RGB mean levels; normalized lift reference 45 RGB levels is existing default not newly inferred constant.
operations.limitation: No separately named three-lane callable found; this actual four-lane operation implements three intervals. Majority blocked samples may drop a rail, requiring railMode review.

operations.contract: Addressed raster px.image.cropped, explicit mask and line origin/heading/stations; profile->edge pair l,r; width=r-l and centre=(l+r)/2; width search best pair. hallwayOf reads straight tee->badge, avoids tee cap/badge, aggregates segment width median/IQR, reports unusable segments.
operations.unitsFrames: canonical cropped raster px, profile luminance mean RGB levels, edge gradient lum/px; centre offsets px. Production registration registerPathLoss(store), tk.s6.hallway.
operations.limitation: Existing width scan 18..59 px, lateral +/-30 px, center gate 3 px, usable length 25 px are prototype local bounds, not global truths. Width IQR measures segment spread, not independent confidence interval. Source mask dilates sprites 2 px; do not silently adopt/mute AA before S7 baseline.

operations.contract: Steps max(1,corridorWidthPx/4), rotates heading halfway toward bestTheta; half-width side samples detect forks. No lateral move toward edge midpoint. bendCount counts contiguous turning phases above existing 2 deg per step, not polygon bend vertices.
operations.unitsFrames: points image/source px with viewportTopPx removed for field indexing; field nearest rounded x/scale,y/scale; theta rad mod pi.
operations.limitation: Longer trace does not identify physical endpoint; termination checks supplied basket bbox before support; no >3-bend exponential prior implemented here.

measuredFindings.finding: Synthetic 30 px nominal bright stripe on uniform background: four-lane expected W=30 scores 1 centered, 0 at +4 px offset; 60 and 90 px stripes score 0 with W=30. Shows width discrimination under this fixture only, not general organic-blob rejection.

Active exact widthSearchAt estimates 29 px for nominal 30 px binary stripe (29 occupied rows), center 0; +4 px origin returns null due center gate. Nominal 60 px stripe returns weak truncated 57 px candidate (4.5 lum/px vs 36 for 29 px); 90 px returns null. Search-bound failure can mimic narrower ribbon.
Uniform supported horizontal field: tracer offsets 0 and +4 px remain exactly at y=80 and y=84 over 45 px, bendCount 0. Following orientation does not center a path.

proposedMath.width: For each validated straight tee->badge segment fit both visible rails; retain (w,c,heading,residuals,visible count). Course-local width distribution from segment fits; compare held-out segments with candidate width banks before narrowing. Scale only from rings; hallway width never sets px/m.
proposedMath.centerline: At a station with independent paired edges, center=(left+right)/2, width=right-left; propagate fit uncertainty, heading error and masks. Nearest field quantization at scale3 is roughly +/-1.5 px per coordinate, orientation bank12 is 15 deg spacing (up to 7.5 deg bin half-width); do not equate these with calibrated uncertainty.
proposedMath.bendPrior: long straight runs and few sharp bends remain hypotheses. Any exponential penalty beyond 3 distinct physical bends needs an explicit bend definition and parameter learned/cross-validated; existing per-step bendCount is unsuitable without conversion.

falsifier.experiment: Calibrate widths on one subset of unoccluded tee->badge segments; predict independent remaining tee->badge and known straight tee->basket rail separations, across full-course and zoom views. Include wide vegetation, crossing ribbons, varying background, shifted tee axes and short/badge-covered segments.
falsifier.failure: Systematic held-out width disagreement exceeding measured rail-fit uncertainty; learned width tracks tee-axis offset/masks; or same-width organic bands score as highly as true ribbons. Synthetic 60px truncation is already a counterexample to trusting any returned edge pair.
